dedupe_keys.name: hengill geothermal microseismicity catalogues and waveforms

description: The Hengill geothermal Figshare collection publishes seismicity catalogues, station coordinates and waveform access scripts from a dense monitoring campaign in Iceland between December 2018 and January 2021. Its eleven members include manual and automatic event catalogues, high- and low-quality classifications, and instructions for retrieving continuous or event waveforms. Geothermal or nearby network modellers can use the events to calibrate seismic hazard assumptions around energy facilities. A monitored geothermal field does not provide a general earthquake rate for every plant, and some waveform files require the separate FDSN queries described in the collection. The individual Figshare items state CC0, whereas the collection DOI registration says CC BY 4.0; this draft follows member rights and records the conflict. I read repository and article metadata without retrieving waveforms. No exact catalogue collection was found. Coverage is the Hengill field during that monitoring campaign. The catalogues support geothermal seismic-hazard simulation, and the related scrtdd repository is a separate event-relocation tool.
